scope: Synthetic known-route advisory research; no physical-bus or automated-dispatch qualification

fit.objective: Equal whole-trip mean squared net-energy error in kWh squared

prediction.template_selection: Training trip nearest median complete duration; stable mission-ID tie break
prediction.remaining_distance: Median training terminal odometer minus latest observed odometer
prediction.auxiliary_assumption: Hold latest good observed auxiliary.power constant

proposed_D18_targets.scope: One forecast at 120 simulation seconds per complete known-route mission; frozen only after validation review
proposed_D18_targets.rationale: Advisory short-trip error budget: mean energy error at most 1 kWh and maximum 2 kWh; maximum charge error 1 point equals 3.5 kWh of declared capacity, one tenth of the illustrative 35-kWh reserve. Envelope width is capped to prevent vacuous coverage. Five of six whole validation/evaluation missions is an empirical count target, not a confidence guarantee or dispatch approval.
